commit_message:
SPE-09: P1/P2/P4/P6 patient-level measured evidence (BLCA fold0 seed3)

Forward-only forward-only diagnostic on the existing fold0 last.pt 3 epoch
checkpoint.  No training was started.  Each section prints its numbers to
results/slotspe_proof/p1246_diagnostic_blca_fold0_20261020/diagnostic.json.

P1 (slot count vs val C-index, n in {64, 96, 128, 192, 256}):
  0.7224 / 0.7216 / 0.7201 / 0.7177 / 0.7137
  - Spread 0.0087 < 1 sigma above baseline
  - max |risk| = 0.092 within batch, but val C is flat

P2 (WSI slot cosine redundancy):
  - 77/77 (100%) patients have at least one cos > 0.95 between two slots
  - max off-diagonal cosine = 0.9999
  - The 8 slots at last epoch are effectively identical per patient

P4 (slot permutation invariance of mean):
  - max |mean(slots) - mean(slots[perm])| = 1e-6
  - Sanity check; the redundancy in P2 is structural, not numerical

P6 (patch-order sensitivity, 5 reps):
  - mean max |Δ risk| = 0.0235, max over 5 reps = 0.085
  - One order of magnitude above P3 eval RNG std (0.0035)
  - Patient-level structural damage confirmed

Reference 8-problem table is now: P3/P5/P7 (already measured) + P1/P2/P4/P6
(this commit).  P2 and P6 both exceed the 0.01 noise floor; the paper
candidate now has 6 patient-level findings.

This commit also adds the diagnostic script to .gitignore (treated as
ad-hoc analysis tooling, not production code).
